Poem of Creation (Enūma eliš) – Standard Babylonian V: “He Made Positions For The Great Gods”

  • Source: eBL corpus – https://www.ebl.lmu.de/corpus/L/1/2/Standard%20Babylonian/V
  • API: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/api/texts/L/1/2/chapters/Standard%20Babylonian/V/display

Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

abu I

  • Meaning: "father" (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab; nom. with pron. suff. abī, M/NB, NA also abū(y)a; abūšu etc.; pl. abbū, O/MA abbā'ū, MB(Alal.), Am. abbūtu) [AD]
  • Logograms: AD
  • Lines: 72, 78, 89, 118, 131
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abu%20I

abullu I

  • Meaning: f.; pl. abullātu(m) "gate (of city or large building)" [ABUL] a. kawītum "outer gate"; maṣṣār a., ša a., mār a., bēl a. "gatekeeper"; OB a. šūdûm "to acquaint s.o. with gate", i.e. to forbid exit; a. edēlu/pehû "to shut/seal up gate"; Bab. "gate tax"; at Nuzi, as a public authority; transf. "entrance" to region, nether world, heaven etc.; OB ext., jB lex. (parts of the organs, esp. portal fissure of the liver);
  • Logograms: ABUL
  • Lines: 9
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abullu%20I

agû I

  • Meaning: "tiara, crown" [AGA] symbol of rule of god, king; transf. jB "corona" of planet, star, sun; OB om. "circle" of oil, incense; jB lex. "ring, band" round axe;
  • Logograms: AGA
  • Lines: 14, 17, 94
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ag%C3%BB%20I

ahrâtaš I

  • Meaning: "for ever after" j/NB(lit.); a. nišī, a. ūmī "for posterity";
  • Lines: 76
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahr%C3%A2ta%C5%A1%20I

ahāzu I

  • Meaning: "to take; marry; learn"
    • G: (a/u)
    • Gt: "be connected with; well versed in"
    • D: (OA infin. also ehhuzum) "mount, plate, inlay" with metal, stone (< ihzu denom.) [GAR(.RA)]; "marry" pl.
    • Dt: pass. of D
    • Štn: "instruct, inform s.o. repeatedly"; OB of disease "infect repeatedly"
    • Št1: OB "be instructed, incited"?
    • Št2: lex. "ignite" fire, "make" fire "catch"
    • N: pass. of G 2 "marry each other"; of fire etc. "catch, spread";
  • Logograms: GAR, GAR.RA
  • Lines: 52, 95
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ah%C4%81zu%20I

ai I

  • Meaning: (before consonant), â, ya "not"
  • Lines: 33
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ai%20I

alālu II

  • Meaning: "to hang up, suspend" Bab.
    • G: (a/u, pres. OB i'allal, jB illal) "hang (up)" people as punishment, "hang up, suspend" objects; stat. OB ext. "is 'hanging'" (wr. halil etc.)
    • Gt: "be tangled; be allied with" also in PNs OAkk, OB
    • D: stat. only ext. "is hung (about) with" s.th.
    • Dt: pass. of D
    • Š: jB in qāta šūlulu "stay o.'s hand"
    • N: of objects "be hung up"; of lamentation "hang (in the air)"?
  • Lines: 71, 99
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81lu%20II

alālu III

  • Meaning: O/jB
    • G: not attested
    • Gt: "to sing a joyful song; boast"
    • Š: "exult, celebrate"
    • Štn: iter. of Š
  • Lines: 81
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81lu%20III

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 77
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ

"various"; NA a(n)nûte ... a(n)nûte ... "some ..., others ..."; (a)kī (h)anni(ma) "thus, in the same way";

    • Gtn: iter. of G, MA "constantly crown" king
    • Gt: stat. "is decked with"
    • D: "put headgear (= acc.) on head of" s.o. (= acc.)

balāṭu II

  • Meaning: "to live" [TI; TI.LA; TIN]
    • G: (u/u, Ass. a/a) stat. "is alive", "is healthy", OB "is solvent"; "live, stay alive, (be allowed to) live"; M/jB, Bogh. "be healed"; j/NB balāṭ napšāti "preservation of life"; OA of debt etc. "be revived, recognized"
    • D: of gods, people "bring back to life, revive"; MA "allow to stay alive", OB "let live; support, provide for"; O/jB "restore to health; cure"; OA, OB "recognize, credit" silver, goods to s.o.; OB "enact, validate" a document
    • Dt: Mari, jB "receive support, be maintained"
    • Š: Am. "give life to"
  • Logograms: TI, TI.LA, TIN
  • Lines: 155
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bal%C4%81%E1%B9%ADu%20II

banû IV

  • Meaning: "to create; build"
    • G: (i/i) [DÙ] of deity "create" person, grain etc.; of person "engender" child, "make" figurine etc.; "build" house, boat; math. "construct"; ext. of feature "form" a shape
    • D: Am. "erect" city
    • Š: lit., caus. of G
    • N: pass.
  • Logograms: DÙ
  • Lines: 20, 39, 73, 75, 120, 133, 135
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ban%C3%BB%20IV

bašû I

  • Meaning: "to be (at hand, available); exist" [GÁL]
    • G: (i/i; no perf.) "be in existence, available"; of eyes, ears "be fixed on, attentive"; of task, responsibility "lie with" s.o.; of power, characteristic "be owned" by s.o.; pret. ibši "was/were" (emphatic); M/NA pres. ibašši, also pl., as adv. ~ "really, in fact; some"; j/NB mala bašû "as much as there is available, everything, everybody"; adi lā bašê (infin.) 'until non-existence' of destruction, disease
    • Š: "bring into being"
    • N: ingress. of G
    • Ntn: "happen repeatedly"
  • Logograms: GÁL
  • Lines: 33, 36, 86, 106
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ba%C5%A1%C3%BB%20I

bašāmu II

  • Meaning: "to create, form" Bab.

šapāku I

  • Meaning: "to heap up; pour on" [DUB; once LAL]
    • G: (a/u) earth, (of gods) the mountains; stat. of clouds "are piled up"; grain etc.; seed, transf. of gods, also in PNs; "pour" liquids, molten metal; OA "invest" capital
    • Gtn: iter. of G "pour repeatedly, in various places" e.g. precious substances in rit.
    • Gt: OA "put on deposit, in store" metal, textiles etc.
    • D: as G "pile up" corpses, mountains, grain; "pour" oil, "cast" bronze
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: pass. of G; of subjects "be prostrated"; of invalid's limbs "be limp"
    • Ntn: [DUB.MEŠ; DUB.DUB ?] iter. of N

ṣabātu I

  • Meaning: "to seize, take; hold"
    • G: (a/a) [DAB]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [DAB.DAB; DAB.MEŠ] "continually engage in" prayers
    • Gt: (infin. etc. tiṣb...) [DAB(.DAB)] "hold one another", "wrestle", "be locked in combat", "engage in litigation"; of parts of body, liver etc. "be interlocked, grown together"; "hold fast" hand, emblem; stat. of ox
    • D: ~ G [DAB; DAB.DAB; DAB.MEŠ] also "enclose, bind, set" with metal (bands); "fasten" roofbeams, thread; "occupy" city; "block" road; "claim" protection (kidinnu)
    • Dtn: iter. "repeatedly take possession of"
    • Dt: pass. of D Am. "be captured"
    • Š: caus. of G [DAB] "direct" s.o.'s attention (pānū) towards (ana); "equip, provide with" income, pasturage, water; often ellipt. "put in place, install" door; "launch" ship; "post" guard; "install" gate-sculptures; "settle" inhabitants; "cause to catch" fire, "ignite"; "make s.o. (start to) do s.th."
    • Štn: pass. of Š NB of work "be started on"
    • Št2: "make o.s. take", OA "gather up" silver; OB "get" troops, animals, tools "ready"; "execute" plan, decision
    • N: pass. of G [DAB]; ~ Gt OA, OB "seize one another", "litigate"
    • Ntn: ~ Gt "be interlocked, grown together"; of teeth "lock each other"
  • Logograms: DAB, DAB.DAB, DAB.MEŠ, DAB DAB.DAB
  • Lines: 68, 75
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/%E1%B9%A3ab%C4%81tu%20I
